summary: Create an EE under Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Execution Environments with name, full image reference, pull policy (always, if not present (default), never), optional description and organization (blank for all orgs) and registry credential, then select it in a job template.
questions: How do I add an execution environment in the AAP UI?
What is the default pull policy for an execution environment?
How do I make an EE available to all organizations?
How do I use a private registry image as an EE?

answer_card.title: Add an execution environment
answer_card.answer_md:
**Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Execution Environments > Create execution environment**
- *Name*, *Image* (full `registry/repo/image:tag`)
- *Pull*: Always / Only if not present (**default**) / Never
- *Organization*: leave blank to share across orgs
- *Registry credential* for protected registries

Then pick it in **Automation Execution > Templates** → job template → *Execution environment*.
